content:
talia-peopleops: Quick rollout note  we're publishing a plain-language refresh to handbook sections: PTO examples, parental leave timelines, and expense receipt guidance. Editorial clarifications only  NO changes to eligibility, accruals, or approval flow. Managers please complete a short 15m "Handbook QuickRead" module and confirm via the manager ack CSV by 2026-12-08. Diff + short brief: https://internal.redwood/handbook/dec-quickread :sparkles:

omar-hr: Uploaded annotated diff and a 1-page highlights PDF to /shared/hr/handbook_dec_quickread/highlights.pdf. Legal reviewed and signed off; see redline: /shared/hr/legal/redline_dec2026.pdf

kevin-englead: Small question  does the expense guidance change receipt thresholds for contractor invoices?

talia-peopleops: No thresholds changed. We clarified acceptable formats: PDF invoice, vendor email invoice, or screenshot that clearly shows vendor name, date, and total. Added an example gallery in the notes.

nora-ic: My manager mapping hasn't synced with LDAP yet. Can we submit manual adds?

omar-hr: Yes. Upload a CSV to SFTP /incoming/hr_manual_mgrs.csv with columns: name,email,team,lead_type. We'll merge and post a pre-export CSV for review within 24 hours.

legal-bot: Legal sign-off: confirmed editorial only. Contact legal@redwood for any edge cases.

reminder-bot: Nudges scheduled  5-day and 1-day reminders before deadline. Training link: https://training.redwood/handbook-quickread (15m).

kevin-englead: Can infra run the export with this command from hr-tools container?

omar-hr: Use: ```bash
./hr_tools export --format=csv --fields=name,email,team,manager_level --filter=active_managers > mgr_ack_dec2026.csv
```

kevin-englead: Thanks. Can you also share a short message I can paste in our team channel? Prefer something one-line for standups.
talia-peopleops: Use this template (adapt as needed): "FYI: minor wording clarifications to PTO & expense receipts (no policy changes). Managers: please finish 15m training by Dec 8 and confirm via manager CSV: <training link>. Q&A drop-in Thu 11am PT."

nora-ic: Completed training ✅

omar-hr: Pre-merge CSV posted to /shared/hr/premerge_mgrs_dec2026.csv. Please flag missing leads within 24h.

kevin-englead: Validated our leads, no manual adds needed.
talia-peopleops: Thanks all  final ack tracker will be published to /shared/hr/ack_dec2026.csv after the audit. If anything reads like a substantive policy change, call it out here immediately. Q&A drop-in invite sent. :eyes:
